subject: Scouting readout: candidate models + Redwood TPS/latency evidence
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@insightmed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Scouting readout: candidate models + Redwood TPS/latency evidence

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the call this morning. Below is a compact readout from our side with recommended next steps if you want to move toward a short pilot. I focused this on the document and perf pieces you asked for (throughput, latency percentiles, and prompt sets).

Summary (1-2 lines):
- Candidate shortlist: GGML-13B-q4 (quantized), Falcon-40B-instruct (fp16), and RedCore-7B-Opt (low-latency variant).
- Redwood-verified evidence attached: TPS snapshots and p95/p99 latency curves for representative prompt mixes.

What we included in the packet (attachments & links):
- redwood_model_profiles_tps_p95.pdf — per-model throughput (TPS) and latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) under varying sequence lengths and mixed prompt mixes.
- insightmed_prompt_set_v1.txt — anonymized prompt set we used for quality + latency traces (short/med/long).
- pilot-scope-checklist.xlsx — sample pilot success criteria, traffic mix, and monitoring hooks.
- Drive link (bench traces + dashboards): https://drive.redwood.com/benchmarks/insightmed/2026-11-22/index.html

Key notes on the profiles:
- GGML-13B-q4: best token cost; consistently high TPS in batching scenarios but p95 latency is sensitive to 2-step prompts (long context + few-shot). We include guidance for split-caching to limit p95 inflation.
- Falcon-40B-instruct: higher-quality on clinical-instruction prompts; higher per-token cost but stable p95 at moderate batch sizes.
- RedCore-7B-Opt: strongest single-request latency (lowest p50/p95) and cheapest for low-latency single-turn queries; lower raw accuracy on some multi-step summarization tasks.

Quality/regression flags we observed:
- A small class (~4%) of the longer discharge-summary prompts produced hallucination-like summaries on RedCore-7B-Opt; we flagged the prompt variations that trigger it (see prompt set with markers).
- Quantized GGML-13B shows slight tokenization artifacts on very long tokens; we provide a pre-tokenization normalization in the prompt pack to mitigate.

Recommended next steps (proposal):
1) Select two candidates for a 3-week pilot: one cost-optimized (GGML-13B-q4) + one quality-focused (Falcon-40B).
2) Pilot scope: 10k simulated requests/day with representative 70/20/10 short/med/long mix (details in checklist).
3) Success criteria: median latency < 350ms, p95 < 1.2s for single-turn, Syntactic/Fact F1 drop < 3% vs baseline prompts.
4) Security & compliance: we'll also send the SOC2 evidence pack and per-model inference isolation checklist — can you confirm whether InsightMed needs an on-prem package or VPC-only?

Ask from your side: confirm preferred candidate models and an internal pilot owner for start-of-pilot scheduling next week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@insightmed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@insightmed.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scouting readout: candidate models + Redwood TPS/latency evidence

Jonas — really helpful, thanks. A couple quick clarifying items:
- For the pilot, we prefer Falcon-40B + RedCore-7B-Opt (quality + latency pair). Cost is secondary for initial validation.
- We will need SOC2 + data residency notes; VPC is preferred but we need the SOC2 evidence to route procurement.
- Can you split the bench link into the short/med/long dashboards so our infra team can triage?

Elaine
Director, Product Ops, InsightMed

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@insightmed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scouting readout: candidate models + Redwood TPS/latency evidence

Great — thanks for the preference. Next actions on our side:
- I uploaded short/med/long dashboards in the Drive link and added a per-slice CSV for your infra team to run the traces. Link takes you directly to the split dashboards.
- Attaching the SOC2 summary and our VPC checklist (sending via secure link in separate email to procurement).
- Karthik will draft the pilot config (traffic mix + canary rollout plan) and Priya will prep the SLO dashboards so you can plug them into your monitoring.

Karthik/Priya — can you confirm you can turn around the pilot config + SLO dashboard by EOD Friday? Also Sean, please add a short note in the pilot checklist about the regression guardrail (the ~4% hallucination class) and suggested sampling for human review.

I'll also open a HubSpot deal note (linked) and attach these artifacts so we have a single record.

Jonas

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@insightmed.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scouting readout: candidate models + Redwood TPS/latency evidence

Quick check-in — pilot config + SLO dashboard are done and attached (pilot-scope-checklist.xlsx). Key highlights:
- Canary rollout over 48 hours, start with 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% if no regression flags.
- Pre-wired sampling: 10% of long-context responses flagged for human review; automated rollback threshold if hallucination sign-rate > 2.5% in sampling window.
- Resource sizing: for expected 10k req/day (70/20/10), we recommend a single 8-GPU pool for Falcon-40B and a 2-GPU pool for RedCore-7B-Opt for predictable p95 targets.

Elaine, copying Sean on infra questions: do you want us to provision the dedicated pools in your account (Redwood Dedicated), or start on Hosted and move to Dedicated after the pilot?

Karthik

[Attachments referenced: insightmed_prompt_set_v1.txt (text), redwood_model_profiles_tps_p95.pdf (pdf), pilot-scope-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
